description: This Java class 'DittoProtocolAdapterProvider' provides an implementation of a ProtocolAdapterProvider that supplies a Ditto protocol adapter instance. It also creates a HeaderTranslator configured with specific headers and blocked header keys based on the ProtocolConfig.

classes.name: DittoProtocolAdapterProvider
classes.description: A provider class that supplies a Ditto ProtocolAdapter instance and creates HeaderTranslator instances with header configurations.

methods.name: DittoProtocolAdapterProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the protocol adapter using DittoProtocolAdapter's static factory method.

methods.name: getProtocolAdapter
methods.description: Returns the stored ProtocolAdapter instance, potentially tailored by userAgent (not used here).

methods.name: createHttpHeaderTranslatorInstance
methods.description: Creates a HeaderTranslator configured with allowed header definitions and blocked header keys from ProtocolConfig.
